meta.name: md2wechat
meta.description: Convert Markdown to WeChat Official Account HTML, inspect supported providers/themes/prompts, generate article images, create drafts, write with creator styles, prepare title suggestions, and remove AI writing traces.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将Markdown快速转为微信公众号文章
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要将Markdown稿件发布到微信公众号
copy.tagline_en: Convert Markdown to WeChat Official Account articles quickly
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often publish Markdown drafts to WeChat Official Account

howto.what: 安装后,Claude 会操作 md2wechat 命令:检查并预览 Markdown 文章,再转成微信公众号 HTML;还能生成封面/配图、创建草稿、给出标题建议、按创作者风格改写、去除 AI 痕迹。发布动作只在明确要求时执行。
howto.when: 当用户要求做微信公众号排版发布相关任务时触发,例如把 Markdown 转成公众号文章、生成文章图片、创建草稿等;也包括索要标题建议、去除 AI 痕迹时。

say.text: 把这份 Markdown 转成微信公众号文章并创建草稿。
say.note: 会执行 convert --draft,需已配置公众号凭证。

say.text: 为这篇文章生成一张封面图。
say.note: 使用 generate_cover 预设生成。

say.text: 给这篇文章生成几个候选标题,钩子等级拉满。
say.note: 调用 title suggest 并返回候选,不直接定稿。

howto.what_en: Claude uses md2wechat to inspect, preview, then convert Markdown into WeChat article HTML. It can also generate cover images, create drafts, suggest titles, rewrite in creator styles, and humanize; uploads/drafts only on explicit request.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for WeChat publishing workflows: converting Markdown to WeChat HTML, generating article images, creating drafts, or title suggestions.

say_en.text: Convert this Markdown to a WeChat article and create a draft.
Generate a cover image for this article.
Propose a few candidate titles for this article, with a higher hook level.
say_en.note: Runs title suggest; returns candidates only.
